nodes.label: chemquest-g8-hub.html (ChemQuest Хими 8 revision hub reference prototype)
nodes.rationale: Self-contained single-page hub: embedded DATA, localStorage progress with optional per-account sync, string-template views fully re-rendered on every action, delegated data-act event handling.

nodes.label: DATA embedded hub content (mn-g8-chemistry v0.1.0: 4 chapters, 11 topics, 40 notes, 106 flashcards, 79 MCQ, 33 questions, 23 practicals, 43 objectives, 47 glossary, 13 errata)
nodes.rationale: Top-level keys meta, chapters, topics, glossary, errata, elements, tables, lab. Topics hold objectives, keyTerms, notes(blocks), flashcards(front/back), quiz(question/options/answer/explanation), questions(stem/level/totalMarks/parts with scheme+model), practicals(aim/steps/safety/result/ref/labActivityId). meta.note: content newly written against textbook chapters/objectives, textbook text/figures/exercises not copied; referenced by page number.

nodes.label: DATA.elements (118 elements: z, symbol, name, mass, category, state, period, group, fRow, config, shells, block, look, color, use)
DATA.tables (17 reference tables: ions, acids, saltreactions, gastests, iontests, apparatus, units, group1, group7, group8, series, halseries, rate, energy, fuels, air, enumbers)
DATA.lab / LAB (apparatus 16, observations 25, hazards 7, structured practical definitions 8)
nodes.rationale: Structured defs (predict, vars, safety MCQ, table with min/max/derive/sample/chart, check rule, concl with marks and scheme) exist for 1.1-prac1, 1.1-prac2, 2.2-prac1, 3.1-prac2, 3.2-prac1, 3.2-prac2, 3.3-prac2, 3.3-prac3; the other 15 practicals are observation-only.

nodes.label: P progress record (localStorage key cq-g8hub-v1)
nodes.rationale: Fields: notes, cards (Leitner box per card), cx (XP-once flags), quizBest, mcq, marks, mx (best marks for XP), rag, xp, last, days {m,xp,n}, log, hist, updatedAt, el, lab, ls, drill.

nodes.label: UI prefs (localStorage cq-g8hub-v1-ui: railOff, focus, level, ecScope, ecMode)
track() activity log
nodes.rationale: One entry per action; same key within 10 min is merged with a count; active minutes accrue when gaps are under 5 min; log capped at 300.

nodes.label: initSync() per-account sync via window.claude db/user
nodes.rationale: Loads doc data/users/<uid>/progress, merges it with local P via mergeP, writes back; stays browser-only (SYNC=local) when no signed-in user; status states syncing/synced/error/full.

nodes.label: vTopic() topic view (notes, cards, quiz, questions, practicals tabs)
tNotes() notes reader with TOC and mark-as-read
quizStart() MCQ session with shuffled options
quizNext() finish quiz, record quizBest and history
tQuestions() structured questions with level filter
tbStart() start mixed test (10/20/30 questions, 1 min each when timed)
nextStep() next recommended action per topic
nodes.rationale: Order: unread notes, cards known <80%, quiz best <80%, question marks <80%, then objectives rated red.

nodes.label: vProgress() My progress dashboard
nodes.rationale: Stats grid, top-3 next-step recommendations, 14-day active-minutes SVG chart, per-topic table, test history, activity log, reset confirmation.

nodes.label: FIGS_EXTRA.ptfull() full 118-element periodic table
nodes.rationale: Colour modes: category, metal/non-metal, Grade-8 first 20, state at 20 °C; search by name/symbol/Z; highlights selected element's group and period; lanthanide/actinide rows below.

nodes.label: vPeriodic() periodic section (table, element cards, mastery map)
ecStart() element flashcard deck (ESCOPE scopes, EMODE modes)
nodes.rationale: Scopes: first 20, first 36, all 118, alkali, alkaline earth, halogens, noble gases, transition 21–30. Modes: symbol→name, name→symbol, Z, position, Bohr (Z≤20 only), appearance/use, electron configuration (high level only), mix.

nodes.label: ALLPRAC / PRAC practical index (23 practicals with topic)
resCheck() result plausibility checks
nodes.rationale: Empty/range validation first, then per-practical rule (range, ice, caGtMg, decreasing, falling, conc, rise, fall) producing ok/warn feedback tied to the expected chemistry.

nodes.label: obsSVG() observation illustrations (tubes, strips, flame, thermometer, powder)
drCheck() check reading within half-division tolerance
vLab() lab skills section (practicals, gear, reading, observations, hazards)
vSearch() search across topics, notes, flashcards, glossary
sampleSVG() element appearance illustration by look
miniPT() mini periodic table position map
FIGS.meniscus (read meniscus bottom at eye level)
FIGS.models (Thomson, Rutherford, Bohr, Chadwick atom models)
FIGS.series (metal reactivity series bars from SERIES)
FIGS.displacer (metal / halogen displacement predictor using MET, HAL, OBS)
FIGS.surface (surface area vs particle size table)
FIGS.pm (hair vs PM10 vs PM2.5 to scale)
document change/input listeners (marks, results, lab text, search)
keydown shortcuts (Space flip, 1–3 rate, arrows, Esc exits focus)
Leitner boxes 0–3 self-rated spaced repetition
nodes.rationale: Rating 1 (Мэдэхгүй) sets box 0 and re-queues the card at the end of the deck; 2 (Эргэлзэж байна) sets box 1; 3 (Мэднэ) sets max(2, prev+1) capped at 3. Box >=2 counts as known; +1 XP awarded once per item via P.cx.

nodes.label: Merge-safe cross-device progress merge
nodes.rationale: 'Combine two progress records without losing work done on either device': newer record (updatedAt) is the base; per-id maps shallow-merged with newer winning; quizBest keeps max per topic; xp = max; days merged with per-field max; log/hist unioned, de-duplicated by time+key, sorted newest first, capped at 300/100.

nodes.label: Inline rich-text markup ({{nuc:A:Z:X}}, X_n subscript, ^n+ superscript, **bold**, *italic*)
nodes.rationale: Content strings carry no HTML; fmt() escapes first, then renders nuclide stacks, subscripts, superscripts, bold and italic. plain() strips the same markup for list labels and search.

nodes.label: Four-step practical flow (Бэлтгэл → Лаборатори → Үр дүн → Дүгнэлт)
nodes.rationale: Prep needs a prediction and, for structured practicals, correct independent/dependent/control variable classification and a correct safety MCQ (otherwise a safety acknowledgement). Lab step: open ChemQuest lab, mark school lab done, or use sample data. Results: data table, live chart and resCheck, or free-text observations. Conclusion compared with a mark scheme or expected result; finishing gives +10 XP.

nodes.label: Self-marked structured questions with mark schemes
nodes.rationale: Student writes an answer, opens the scheme and ticks points present; each part is capped at its marks; model answer shown; XP granted only for increases over the best (P.mx).

nodes.label: RAG objective self-assessment (Чадахгүй / Дунд зэрэг / Итгэлтэй)
nodes.rationale: Each objective rated r/a/g; clicking the same rating clears it; red objectives feed next-step recommendations.

nodes.label: Topic progress formula (mean of notes, cards, quiz, questions, practicals)
nodes.rationale: Notes read fraction, cards known (box>=2) fraction, best quiz %, self-marked marks fraction, practicals finished fraction; lab term dropped when a topic has no practicals; >=80% shows a tick in the rail.

nodes.label: XP reward scheme
nodes.rationale: +5 note read, +1 per card/element/lab-skill card first known, +2 first correct MCQ, +1 per new self-marked mark above previous best, +10 practical finished, +2 every 5-answer reading-drill streak. XP chip notes future merge with ChemQuest XP.

nodes.label: Hash route scheme (#t<topic>, #progress, #reftables, #periodic, #elements, #elementmap, #lab…)
nodes.rationale: Routes: #t<topicId>, #checklist, #test, #glossary, #tools, #errata, #review, #progress, #reftables/#tables, #periodic, #elements, #elementmap, #lab, #labgear, #labread, #labobs, #labhaz. go() writes via history.replaceState; fromHash() restores on load.

nodes.label: labActivityId ChemQuest lab deep-link placeholder
nodes.rationale: Every practical carries labActivityId (null for all 23 here). 'ChemQuest лабораторид нээх' marks the lab step done and toasts that integration will open the matching lab practical; the 'lab' action toasts that it will navigate by labActivityId. Note warns the 3D lab may not open on phones, so sample data is offered.

nodes.label: Lab-notebook design tokens (copper-sulfate blue accent, Bunsen-flame orange tips)
nodes.rationale: Tokens on :root: bg/surface/sunk/ink/line, --accent #136F9E, --flame for exam tips, good/bad/amber status colours, metal/non-metal/noble and 10 element-category colours; dark theme via prefers-color-scheme and data-theme. A later 'minimal pass' uses one paper colour and hairlines instead of boxes. Fonts: Literata display, Golos Text body, JetBrains Mono numbers.

nodes.label: Topic rail + reading column layout with focus mode
nodes.rationale: Fixed 288px topic rail beside the reading column; under 900px the rail becomes a slide-in drawer with a scrim; on desktop the menu button hides the rail; focus mode hides rail, search, XP, crumbs and TOC (Esc exits); safe-area insets respected.

nodes.label: Note content block types (p, list, steps, table, key, eq, tip, warn, fact, errata, ex, fig)
nodes.rationale: key = definition box with term; tip = exam tip; warn = common mistake; fact = extra fact; errata = textbook correction; ex = worked example with hidden solution; fig = named figure with args and caption.

nodes.label: Middle / high school level toggle (Дунд анги / Ахлах анги)
nodes.rationale: UI.level 'high' adds full and noble-gas-core electron configuration, block and valence electrons to element panels and enables the configuration flashcard mode; mid level shows shells only and notes Z>20 shell detail is for upper grades.

nodes.label: Хими VIII textbook (4th ed. 2022, ISBN 978-99962-74-32-9)
nodes.rationale: Curriculum: ЕБС 12 жилийн хөтөлбөр, 8-р анги, Хими. Hub content is rewritten to its chapters and objectives and cites page numbers only; errata view lists 13 textbook errors or simplifications found during review.

hyperedges.label: Leitner self-rated decks (topic flashcards, element cards, lab-skill cards)
Progress persistence and account sync flow
Periodic table renderers (full table, mastery map, mini position map, first-20 grid)
